# pillar-csi

> pillar-csi is a Kubernetes CSI driver that exports ZFS zvols and LVM logical volumes from storage nodes to pods over NVMe-oF/TCP or iSCSI, and ZFS datasets over NFSv4.2. It installs as one Helm release: a controller, an agent on each storage node, and a node plugin on each worker.

Shipped today: ZFS zvols and datasets, LVM logical volumes, NVMe-oF/TCP, iSCSI and NFSv4.2; Filesystem and Block modes where the protocol permits; online expansion; ReadWriteOnce, ReadWriteOncePod and ReadOnlyMany, plus ReadWriteMany for NFS; optional mTLS between controller and agent. NFS uses a fixed TCP port 2049, root squash by default, and no per-volume protocol tunables. SMB is planned, not available. pillar-csi does not replicate data; each volume lives on one storage node. License: Apache-2.0. Source: https://github.com/isac322/pillar-csi

## Docs

- [Documentation home](https://pillar-csi.bhyoo.com/docs/): overview and entry points
- [Tutorial: your first PVC](https://pillar-csi.bhyoo.com/docs/tutorials/first-pvc/): from one storage node to a Pod with a mounted volume
- [Configure NFS](https://pillar-csi.bhyoo.com/docs/how-to/configure-nfs/): ZFS dataset backend, NFSv4.2, RWX, ACLs, expansion and recovery
- [Install with Helm](https://pillar-csi.bhyoo.com/docs/how-to/install-helm/): chart install, values, upgrade, uninstall
- [Prerequisites](https://pillar-csi.bhyoo.com/docs/reference/prerequisites/): kernel modules, Kubernetes and Helm versions, ports
- [Support matrix](https://pillar-csi.bhyoo.com/docs/reference/support-matrix/): what is supported and what is planned
- [Architecture](https://pillar-csi.bhyoo.com/docs/explanation/architecture/): how the controller, agent, and node plugin split the work
- [CRD reference](https://pillar-csi.bhyoo.com/docs/reference/crd/): PillarAgent, PillarStore, PillarProtocol, PillarStorageClass fields
- [Helm values](https://pillar-csi.bhyoo.com/docs/reference/helm-values/): every chart value
- [Troubleshooting](https://pillar-csi.bhyoo.com/docs/how-to/troubleshooting/): common failures and fixes
- [FAQ](https://pillar-csi.bhyoo.com/docs/community/faq/)
